verdict.rationale: Make's API Reference pages on developers.make.com render a live "Test it" runner for each operation, backed by an OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec, so users can explore endpoints and execute requests interactively. Requests go to production zone URLs with no test server, and the spec is not linked as a download; standard OpenAPI paths return 404. Missing for 10: a sandbox/test environment for safe runnable examples, a discoverable OpenAPI download, and independent hands-on corroboration of the runner.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
